fusions.name: Quill Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a hair stiffened into a quill at a target up to 8 tiles away for 4 piercing damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave a strand trailing from the target, [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Buffeting Fan
fusions.desc: Spreads your hair into a wing and beats it once, dealing 11 wind damage to everything in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you and knocking it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Jessed Hawk
fusions.desc: Looses a hawk on a jess of plaited hair for 12 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Hollow Shafts
fusions.desc: Your hairs grow hollow shafts: you move 8% faster and your wind resistance rises by 10%.
